name: Multimodal Species Recognition Agent
description: Identifies an animal species from one supplied photograph paired with a text instruction, by classifying the image into ranked taxonomic labels. Covers determining which species appears in a supplied photograph and answering 'what animal is this' about an image the user provides. It does NOT search for similar animals or similar images, and it owns no reference-image collection. Requires BOTH an image and a non-empty text instruction in the same request - it cannot identify a species from a text description alone, and it cannot accept an image with no instruction. Returns identified, uncertain or not_identified; an inconclusive result is a real answer, not a failure.
managed_services: BioCLIP-2 label classification, executed remotely on the official public Space imageomics/bioclip-2-demo (model target imageomics/bioclip-2); a fixture-backed mock remains available for offline development and is disclosed as mock whenever it runs
GBIF Species API, queried live per candidate; annotation only, and it never selects, reorders or rescores a species
NCBI Taxonomy via Entrez E-utilities, queried live per candidate under a request-rate safety margin; annotation only
Azure OpenAI GPT-5 mini as a bounded planner and grounded explainer, at most two calls per request; it decides nothing scientific
delegation: When a request asks for a capability this agent does not own, it returns a needs_agent result naming the capability. It never calls another agent itself; routing is the Global Orchestrator's responsibility, and that integration does not exist yet.
capabilities: Top-K taxonomic classification of one photograph
does_not_provide: Visual similarity search between animals or images
